fire: In fencing, the foil is held in the right hand while the left arm stays raised behind you.
On this course the rough is cut long between the fairway and the trees on the left.
Keep the bat close to the pad and lean over the front foot when you defend.
The tee box sits on a ridge above the narrow fairway that bends to the right.
Grip the club with the left hand on top and the thumb pointing down the shaft.
The bunker guards the front of the green, so most players aim for the back.
In archery, the bow is held in the left hand and the string drawn to the chin.
The serve must land in the diagonal box on the far side of the net.
quiet: At dinner, the fork is placed on the left and the knife on the right of the plate.
The meeting is held in the evening and usually runs for about an hour.
Keep the receipt close to the invoice and file both at the end of the month.
The town hall sits on a hill above the market square in the old town.
Hold the baby with one hand under the head while you wash the hair.
The bakery stands at the front of the street, so most people stop there first.
In winter, the plant is kept in a warm room and watered once a week.
The letter must arrive in the post office before the end of the week.
